review.summary: Resolve entries in the native OS2 module ordinal table.
review.contract: The static table size must equal ORD_NENTRIES before access. OS module loading and function lookup are separate operations.
evidence: Producer predicates and adjacent control flow inspected during the Load family review.

review.contract: dlopen failure throws only when fail is set; this is native DLL loading, not Perl require.
evidence: Producer predicates and adjacent control flow inspected during the Load family review.

perlstatic.h.manifest_description: Like inline.h, but functions not declared inline

review.summary: Control-oriented opcode implementations, including eval, exception delivery, dispatch/on, loops, and Perl report-picture parsing/execution.
terminology_traps: A report picture is the first argument to formline, not a printf format.
This file contains several unrelated language subsystems; use the enclosing function.

review.summary: Compile a Perl report/formline picture to FF instructions cached as format magic.
review.contract: Rejects an empty picture and the combination of ~~ repetition with a non-chopping numeric field. The latter is a nontermination check, not recursive-call detection.
callers: pp_formline calls doparseform before executing the cached FF instructions.
evidence: len == 0 guard
repeat set on ~~; unchopnum set for non-chopping numeric fields; final unchopnum && repeat guard

review.summary: Leave eval context and enforce require completion.
review.contract: Only require applies the false-result and failed-compilation actions. INC cache handling differs between those actions.
evidence: Producer predicates and adjacent control flow inspected during the Load family review.

review.summary: Load Perl source through require/do and INC hooks.
review.contract: Validates filenames, resolves cached load state, calls INC/INCDIR hooks, opens source and records lookup failure with its context. Explicit hook failures preserve the original exception.
evidence: Producer predicates and adjacent control flow inspected during the Load family review.

pp_hot.c.manifest_description: Push/Pop code for heavily used opcodes

review.summary: System and IO opcode implementations, including write/report-format selection and pagination.
terminology_traps: write uses Perl report formats; printf uses the separate scalar printf formatter.
A missing optional top format can be skipped; do not infer an error from its absence alone.

review.summary: Select and invoke the body format used by write.
review.contract: The selected GV must contain a format CV. GvFORM(fgv) being NULL triggers UNDEFINED_FORMAT_CALLED.
evidence: GvFORM(fgv) check before doform(cv, gv, PL_op->op_next)

review.summary: Finish report output and invoke a top-of-page format when pagination requires it.
review.contract: Initial lookup can skip a missing top format. A cached selected top GV whose format CV is absent triggers UNDEFINED_TOP_FORMAT_CALLED; these paths must not be conflated.
callers: Runs after the body format and may invoke doform for the top format.
evidence: topgv lookup can goto forget_top
later GvFORM(IoTOP_GV(io)) check before doform

review.summary: Regular expression parsing and compilation, including bracketed character classes and extended set-expression syntax.
terminology_traps: Regexp compilation can happen during compilation or at runtime.
handle_regex_sets parses (?[...]); regclass is also called for operands inside those sets.

review.summary: Parse the extended regexp character-class set-expression construct (?[...]).
review.contract: Uses operator/operand stacks and precedence to combine character sets. Unexpected binary-operator diagnostics here concern extended character-class expression syntax.
callers: Regexp parser delegates the (?[...]) construct to this helper.
evidence: Handle the (?[...]) construct to do set operations comment
REGEX_UNEXPECTED_BINARY_OPERATOR calls in operator/operand handling

review.summary: Parse bracketed regexp character classes, or individual class operands when requested.
review.contract: Can produce regexp nodes or an inversion list. Callers can request stop_at_1 and ret_invlist; a diagnostic here is not automatically exclusive to ordinary classes.
callers: Used for ordinary bracketed classes and operands of extended set expressions.
evidence: stop_at_1 and ret_invlist parameters
ANYOF and multi-character-fold behavior documented in function comment

review.summary: Scalar allocation, representation, conversion, copying and destruction; also implements printf-style SV formatting.
terminology_traps: A formatting error in sv_vcatpvfn is not a Perl report-format error.
An ambient PL_op can identify the caller, not necessarily the underlying formatting operation.

review.summary: Append printf-style formatted output using C varargs or an array of SV arguments.
review.contract: Handles conversions, flags, width and precision. CANNOT_PRINTF specifically rejects infinity or NaN for %c. It is also reachable through C/XS formatting APIs, independently of the current opcode.
callers: Perl_do_sprintf reaches this formatter through sv_vsetpvfn.
Other sv_*pvf/pvfn APIs can call the formatter.
evidence: Perl_isinfnan(nv) followed by c == c guard and PERL_THROW_CANNOT_PRINTF
signature accepts both va_list and SV-array inputs

review.summary: Remove the most recently installed matching source filter.
review.contract: An empty filter stack returns normally. A non-top filter cannot be removed through this API.
evidence: Producer predicates and adjacent control flow inspected during the Load family review.

review.contract: Nonempty export requests to UNIVERSAL fail. Other packages follow missing-method warnings, except the special _charnames path.
evidence: Producer predicates and adjacent control flow inspected during the Load family review.

review.summary: Validate an embedding caller against linked libperl.
review.contract: Interpreter size, interpreter pointer/multiplicity and API version must match. A mismatch can originate from a different caller configuration, not an internal memory corruption.
evidence: Producer predicates and adjacent control flow inspected during the Load family review.

review.summary: Validate and establish the extension/interpreter bootstrap contract.
review.contract: Checks packed layout/context identity and Perl API versions. Incompatible binaries use the existing no-Perl delivery paths; XS release-version checking is delegated to xs_version_bootcheck.
evidence: Producer predicates and adjacent control flow inspected during the Load family review.

review.summary: Compare an XS object release version with the requested Perl-side version.
review.contract: An explicit bootstrap argument takes precedence over package XS_VERSION and VERSION. This is independent of Perl API compatibility.
evidence: Producer predicates and adjacent control flow inspected during the Load family review.
